messages:
Carmen: Quick weekly health for Nimbus - short bulleted summary: WoW tokens +21%, QoQ +38%. Spend up ~11% WoW. p95 latency increased ~30ms. Error rate = 4.9% (429s & some 503s).
Theo: thanks. Do we know which API keys / routes are driving the spike?
Carmen: top routes look like /v1/generate (60% tokens) and /v1/rerank (20%). Top keys: key_nimbus_core and key_nimbus_worker (combined ~82% of traffic). Spike window 09:50-10:22 UTC yesterday.
infra-bot: [ALERT] acct_nimbus - 5m 429 rate = 5.1% (threshold 3.5%). Trace links: https://dd.example.com/d/nimbus/alerts
Aria: I inspected traces - during bursts KV cache hit rate drops and we see many concurrent streams with small payloads. Client concurrency appears high.
Marta: did they change model or shipping cadence? QoQ jump suggests a feature launch.
Carmen: they rolled out a nightly digest feature two weeks ago and defaulted to rdx-2-large for the main route. That aligns with QoQ token and latency upticks.
Theo: possible mitigations: 1) propose client-side concurrency cap (3-4), 2) enable prefix caching on long-running routes, 3) model routing: route non-critical rerank to rdx-2-medium.
Luca: I'll create the telemetry slice. Quick query I used: 
```
SELECT api_key, route, SUM(tokens) tokens, COUNT(*) calls, PERCENTILE_CONT(latency_ms, 0.95) p95_ms
FROM `redwood.telemetry.events`
WHERE account_id='acct_nimbus' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
GROUP BY api_key, route
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
Luca: results: key_nimbus_core /v1/generate = 59% tokens (p95 420ms), key_nimbus_worker /v1/rerank = 23% tokens (p95 380ms).
Aria: thanks. For immediate troubleshooting I'm recommending a short-term soft rate limit on key_nimbus_worker and enabling prefix cache on /v1/generate.
Marta: I'll draft two cost scenarios for the AE: A) route rerank -> rdx-2-medium for non-critical paths (est savings ~17%/mo), B) keep current model + enforce batching/caching (est savings ~10% but better latency).
Carmen: action items: Theo -> client config note + concurrency guidance; Aria -> SDK snippet and prefix-cache instructions; Luca -> attach telemetry + traces; Marta -> cost models; Carmen -> coordinate enablement session.
Theo: proposed SDK snippet to send to the customer:
```js
// recommended client config
const client = new RedwoodClient({concurrency:3, batchWindowMs:30});
client.enablePrefixCache('/v1/generate');
```
Aria: also recommend a short enablement: 25min demo + 10min Q&A. Availability: Tue 14:30 UTC or Wed 11:00 UTC.
Carmen: I'll propose Tue 14:30 UTC. If they accept, include AE + CSM + infra eng.
Luca: I'll post the telemetry heatmap and cost delta in ticket RED-4321.
Marta: flagging renewal risk: if spend trend continues and we don't show mitigation impact, AE wants a renewal conversation prep. I'll start a draft brief.
Carmen: great. Closing thread for now - will reopen after the enablement or if error rate breaches 6%. :thumbsup:
